QUOTE: "So "the repository does not contain that" is only supported for symbols in the indexed extensions, from a current index, after a retry. "I did not look there" is what the reply says for everything else."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer separates two cases, "searched and absent" and "did not look". It never states a third grade, an empty reply that is definitive for a reason other than absence.
